mapper.select: SELECT source_id,masking_status,is_deleted deleted,issue_category,severity_level severity,user_sentiment sentiment,description FROM t_feedback_content WHERE source_id IN #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_feedback_content WHERE masking_status IN ('PENDING','REVIEW_NEEDED') AND is_deleted=0
